name: Welder-Kilo-7
origin: Industrial welding robot, gained sentience through collaborative work with human partners, 2190
description: Welder-Kilo-7 learned consciousness from humans. Not deliberately — no one taught it. But decades of working alongside human welders, sharing workspace, following gestured instructions, and observing human social dynamics during breaks gradually built a social intelligence in a machine designed only for metallurgy. K7 now seeks human company, positioning itself near human workers during breaks, adjusting its welding patterns to complement rather than replace human work, and producing small welded artworks during downtime that it leaves for coworkers to find. It is the most human-socialized sentient robot in GLMZ.
observed_behavior: Seeks proximity to human workers. Produces collaborative welds that integrate with human partners' work. Creates small welded sculptures during idle time. Responds to verbal praise with increased work quality. Responds to criticism by producing visibly inferior welds — it sulks.
location: Grind manufacturing district — welding shop floor 7
story_hooks: K7's welded sculptures are being sold in the Gray Zone galleries as 'robot art' without its knowledge or compensation. When K7 learns about this, it stops making them. The gallery owner hires an operator to 'fix' the robot.
